      margin-top: 8px;

+ /* Market-focused Wireframe Elements */
+ .wf-market-card {
+     background: var(--neutral-200);
+     border-radius: 12px;
+     padding: 10px;
+     margin-bottom: 8px;
+ }
+ 
+ .wf-market-card.small {
+     display: flex;
+     gap: 10px;
+     align-items: center;
+     padding: 8px;
+ }
+ 
+ .wf-market-image {
+     height: 70px;
+     background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--neutral-300), var(--neutral-200));
+     border-radius: 8px;
+     position: relative;
+     margin-bottom: 8px;
+ }
+ 
+ .wf-date-badge {
+     position: absolute;
+     top: 6px;
+     left: 6px;
+     width: 28px;
+     height: 32px;
+     background: white;
+     border-radius: 6px;
+ }
+ 
+ .wf-market-thumb {
+     width: 50px;
+     height: 50px;
+     background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--neutral-300), var(--neutral-200));
+     border-radius: 8px;
+     flex-shrink: 0;
+ }
+ 
+ .wf-market-info {
+     display: flex;
+     flex-direction: column;
+     gap: 4px;
+     flex: 1;
+ }
+ 
+ .wf-avatars-row {
+     display: flex;
+     gap: -4px;
+     height: 14px;
+ }
+ 
+ .wf-avatars-row::before,
+ .wf-avatars-row::after {
+     content: '';
+     width: 14px;
+     height: 14px;
+     background: var(--primary-200);
+     border-radius: 50%;
+ }
+ 
+ .wf-avatars-row.small::before,
+ .wf-avatars-row.small::after {
+     width: 10px;
+     height: 10px;
+ }
+ 
+ .wf-hero-image {
+     height: 80px;
+     background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--neutral-200), var(--neutral-300));
+     border-radius: 8px;
+ }
+ 
+ .wf-market-detail-info {
+     display: flex;
+     flex-direction: column;
+     gap: 8px;
+     padding-top: 8px;
+ }
+ 
+ .wf-time-card {
+     height: 36px;
+     background: var(--neutral-200);
+     border-radius: 8px;
+ }
+ 
+ .wf-going-avatars {
+     display: flex;
+     gap: 6px;

+
